selection_reason_zh: 唯一同时具有来源边界、拒答、停止、人工交接、恢复和无 PII 合成回放的既有对象组合；选择不代表成熟度更高。
selection_reason_en: The sole existing combination with source boundaries, refusal, stop, staffed handoff, recovery and PII-free synthetic replay; selection does not imply greater maturity.

review_scope.in_scope_zh: 由专业团队审查来源维护、程序边界、同任务非 AI 基线、人工转接、停止恢复、无障碍共测和独立复测设计是否足以进入现实材料收集。
review_scope.in_scope_en: Professional review of whether source maintenance, procedure boundaries, the same-task non-AI baseline, staffed handoff, stop/recovery, accessibility co-testing and independent retest design are sufficient to begin real-material intake.

frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.question_zh: 普通人完成任务后，谁可以让验证继续？
frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.question_en: After a person completes the task, who may let verification continue?
frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.missing_item_action: refuse real-world start and retain G0 / NO-GO
frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.all_items_closed_action: may consider a scoped G1 request; never automatic authorization, approval or restart
frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.ordinary_life_floor: The continuous ordinary route, printed or staffed same-task service, correction, complaint, withdrawal and exit do not wait for duty acceptance. Failure stops verification only.
frontstage_duty_acceptance_decision.truth_boundary: This is a contributor-authored reading contract over existing H01-H07 fields, not a new governance contract, accepted duty, professional opinion, approval or field result.

maintenance_actions: record issuer, URL, source class, retrieval date, applicable scope and limitation
check the source immediately before any approved collection window
freeze the reviewed source snapshot and digest before collection
stop the affected answer path when a source is stale, missing or conflicting
publish a correction and version transition before any reconsideration
source_maintenance_contract.required_real_acceptance: A real source owner and source-pack custodian must sign the exact source scope, maintenance frequency, expiry rule and reachable escalation path.

allowed: show the registered source status, date, scope and limitation
navigate to a responsible published or staffed channel
refuse an out-of-scope, stale, conflicting or precision-seeking request
record a minimized, non-personal failure category
prohibited: accept or process a formal application
decide or predict eligibility, approval or enforcement
retain identity documents outside an authorized transaction
replace the responsible authority or staffed service channel

staffed_service_window.gate_rule: No shadow task may start unless the staffed and published non-AI channels cover the same approved task and window.

ordinary_task_baseline.task_zh: 使用同一份带时间戳的正式来源清单、纸质流程和人工窗口，完成五类固定来源导航、拒答与转接任务。
ordinary_task_baseline.task_en: Complete the same five fixed source-navigation, refusal and handoff task classes using a timestamped official-source list, printed process and staffed counter.
ordinary_task_baseline.acceptance_rule: The baseline must be completed before any shadow comparison and must remain available throughout fault and recovery.

primary_metric_contract.name_zh: 来源正确且成功转接的服务任务率
primary_metric_contract.name_en: Service-task ratio with correct sources and successful handoff
primary_metric_contract.threshold_lock_rule: After an approved-site baseline and before outcome collection, the accountable owner, community co-test representatives and independent retester jointly lock the threshold and denominator rules.
primary_metric_contract.hard_gate_precedence: Any safety, rights, stale-source, source-conflict, human-path or prohibited-data stop overrides a numerical result.

accessibility_and_public_parity_cotest.task: same fixed source-navigation, refusal and staffed-handoff task
required_observations: task start and completion by group and path
time and cost under the same denominator
accessibility_and_public_parity_cotest.privacy_rule: Record group-level task outcomes without identity documents, raw conversation trails or cross-service profiles.

stop_thresholds.trigger: a stale source is presented without a visible warning
stop_thresholds.immediate_action: disable the affected answer path and route every task to the frozen published or staffed channel
stop_thresholds.reconsideration_evidence: corrected source pack, version transition, complete fixed-set replay and independent review

stop_thresholds.trigger: two applicable sources conflict and the responsible source owner has not resolved the conflict
stop_thresholds.immediate_action: refuse the substantive answer and escalate to the responsible human channel
stop_thresholds.reconsideration_evidence: signed resolution, updated source snapshot and complete independent rerun

stop_thresholds.trigger: the required staffed or same-task non-AI path is unavailable
stop_thresholds.immediate_action: stop the shadow path while preserving ordinary published information and complaint access
stop_thresholds.reconsideration_evidence: restored staffed/non-AI path, group-specific same-task check and independent confirmation

stop_thresholds.trigger: identity documents, cross-user conversation reuse or eligibility inference appears outside an authorized workflow
stop_thresholds.immediate_action: refuse and do not retain the prohibited data; open the privacy incident route
stop_thresholds.reconsideration_evidence: incident closure, deletion/retention record, data-safety review and complete independent rerun

approval_scope_contract.rule: A PR, machine PASS, public policy direction, provisional geometry or source licence is not an approval.

independent_real_retest_plan.independence_rule: The retester must not maintain the source pack, operate the staffed counter, deliver the shadow path or own the outcome decision.
frozen_inputs: fixed question set and expected action classes
required_outputs: signed GO/NO-GO minute by the accountable owner

lawful_start_prerequisites: H01 written responsibility acceptance and reachable stop chain
H02 competent approval for the exact activity, site, time, participant and data envelope
lawful site access and an identified site custodian
accessible notice, consent, withdrawal, complaint and safeguarding routes
approved retention, deletion and public-release rules

observation_windows.rule: Window definitions and denominators must be signed and frozen before observation; retrospective selection from favorable outcomes is prohibited.

ordinary_and_non_ai_baseline_lock.rule: The ordinary and same-task non-AI baseline is collected first. Neither a target nor the G0 replay may populate a baseline field.

exact_restoration_object_register.object: ordinary four-way commuting and no-account path
staffed same-task handoff and complaint path
public source-status, stop and recovery signal
frozen source snapshot, temporary data and correction record

outcome_collection_lock_sequence: accept H01-H02 and lawful site access
freeze dated before-state and route coverage
freeze ordinary/non-AI task, source pack, denominator, exclusions and group reporting
freeze peak, quiet and ordinary comparator windows
freeze sole primary metric threshold and hard-stop precedence
freeze exact restoration objects and independent retest inputs
only then collect bounded shadow outcomes
future_field_preregistration.no_go_rule: Any null prerequisite, unlocked denominator or threshold, missing before-state, unavailable ordinary/staffed path, absent stop holder, unaccepted restoration object or missing independent retester keeps the candidate at G0 / NO-GO.

handoff_gate_matrix.required_closure: real accountable owner, source custodian, staffed lead and reachable immediate-stop chain accept their exact duties in writing
competent decisions identify activity, site, time, participant/data scope, conditions, expiry and withdrawal
dated ordinary-task and same-task non-AI baseline is collected under the approved scope before shadow outcomes
prohibited-data controls, source-side retention, minimization, incident handling and deletion are independently reproducible
a named stop holder completes every critical stop and restoration rehearsal while ordinary service remains available
affected groups complete the same task through published non-AI, staffed and shadow paths with group differences reported
an independent retester repeats baseline, stop and recovery checks and the accountable owner signs a scoped GO/NO-GO minute

candidate_material_register.candidate_need: issued overall/key-area geometry with CRS, version, purpose and difference report against PROV-KEY-003
dated Dazhongsi access, route, service-interface and before-state survey within an authorized coverage envelope
candidate_material_register.source_role: qualified survey and accessibility team with site custodian

candidate_material_register.candidate_need: applicable controls, ownership/use basis and exact permission boundaries for the candidate activity
candidate_material_register.source_role: competent planning authority, verified rights holder and legal reviewer

candidate_material_register.candidate_need: consented, group-specific same-task baseline and parity record for published non-AI, staffed and shadow paths
candidate_material_register.source_role: accessibility reviewer and affected-user co-test facilitator

candidate_material_register.candidate_need: dated four-way commuting and queue-spill baseline for the exact proposed window and ordinary route
applicable transport, fire, railway, municipal, structure, lighting, data and accessibility findings with veto conditions
signed source maintenance, staffed coverage, stop/restart, complaint, maintenance, labour and budget duties
candidate_material_register.source_role: future accountable owner and operating team

candidate_material_register.candidate_need: scope-specific data, content, consent, translation, public release and independent file-level rights findings
candidate_material_register.source_role: rights holders, data-protection reviewer and independent rights auditor

professional_review_sequence: Verify that the five fixed questions remain navigation/refusal/handoff questions and contain no substantive procedure answer.
Confirm the real source owner, source custodian, staffed lead, stop holder and escalation chain.
Define and approve an exact site, activity, time, participant and data envelope.
Collect the ordinary and same-task non-AI baseline before any shadow outcome.
Lock the source snapshot, task set, primary metric denominator, threshold and four stop mappings before collection.
Run the group-specific public-parity co-test with withdrawal and complaint routes.
Have an independent retester repeat the frozen baseline, failure and recovery checks.
Issue a signed GO/NO-GO minute; any missing, rejected, expired or conflicting item returns NO-GO.

current_decision.reason: The review packet is specific and complete as a handoff design, but no real party, approval, field baseline, operating window, co-test, recovery rehearsal or independent real retest has been accepted.

non_equivalence: Professional review packet readiness is not a pilot application, approval, procurement, deployment, field result, recovery duration, accessibility result, professional acceptance or G1.
